The main takeaway from our work is that
a single cell can be used to generate a library of different cell lines.

the red blood cell cytosol contains a factor that inhibits the proliferation of K562 cells and promotes their differentiation, and that this factor affects the expression of a number of genes, including β-hemoglobin, and causes changes in the composition of the intermediate filaments in K562 cells.
